title.narrative: Improving Nursing Quality and Capacity Project

description.narrative: The project is aligned with the following impacts: effective health care focused on the needs of the population provided, and equitable access to health services ensured (footnote 26). The project will have the following outcome: quality and quantity of nurses and midwives improved. The project has three outputs (i) Nursing educational institution modernized; (ii) Quality of nursing education and training improved; and (iii) Role of nurses in health service delivery strengthened.
